system.description: A computer program the immunosecurity system initiates that tracks heroes who have attempted to circumvent security systems and attacks them using the lab’s automated systems: lasers, knockout gas, sonic weapons, electroshock weapons, etc. (1 per 2 heroes (immunosecurity).)
system.tactics: Any hero interacting with the security or computer systems is a target for the Inhibitor Process, who seeks to drive away intruders with Attacks and Hinders.

system.description: Inherent: As a computer program, an Inhibitor Process is only susceptible to computer-based technological attacks. Physical attacks against it are ineffective.
